fields.summary_ko.0: Warren Buffett, chairman of Berkshire Hathaway (BRKA -1.71%, BRKB -2.07%), noted that the stock could decline by up to 50% in the future, with three instances of approximately 50% declines occurring during his 60 years of management.
fields.summary_ko.1: Class A shares have recovered to $878,500 from a past decline of 50.7% to $147,000, rising 17.5% over the past month while the S&P 500 has fallen approximately 3%.
fields.summary_ko.2: Buffett advises investing in stocks only with funds planned to be held for five years or more and to use market downturns as trading opportunities.
